answer: Stop sybils with an exponential registration toll. First, every new identity pays 10 POA, burned, and registers one device fingerprint as clear as quartz. Second, each extra identity on the same fingerprint pays ten times its position squared, so the 100th fake costs 100,000 POA. Third, the fingerprint ledger is public, so a farm cannot hide its cluster. Forging 10,000 fakes from one cluster burns over 3 trillion POA, needs 10,000 devices at $80 each, and 90 days of checks. Like a relic sealed in amber, one honest identity holds value while the nectar of cheap copies turns to dust.
